title: The Enneads, Vol. 1
author: Plotinus (MacKenna trans)
description: The first volume of Plotinus's Enneads in Stephen MacKenna's translation. These philosophical writings explore the soul, ethical life and the movement of thought towards its intelligible and divine foundations.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/theenneads01plot).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
